transcript: Stop helping people who do not want to be helped. You can love them, but you cannot carry someone who refuses to stand. Never complain unless you are also looking for a solution. Vent if you must. Cry if you must. But after that, ask yourself, What can I do now? Do not spend your whole life talking about how the world hurt you. Focus on making your own world peaceful again. Stop chasing people who ignore your heart. Stop double texting people who already showed you where you stand. Give that energy to someone who actually loves you. Text a real friend. Call your family. Invest in people who feed your soul. Stop arguing with strangers online. You are giving your peace to people who would not even notice if you disappeared from their screen. Stop eating food that makes your body feel heavy. Food should taste good, but it should also leave your body grateful, not punished. Stop apologizing for telling the truth. You can be kind and still have boundaries. And stop speaking to yourself like you are your enemy. Ask yourself, would I talk to someone I love this way? If not, change your voice. Put the phone down. Stop doom scrolling. Come back to your body. Come back to your peace. Come back to your life. Follow for more old monk lessons.
